mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies along the Military Ridge State Trail under a First Quarter moon. If you are up early, the ISS will be visible at 4:54 AM, appearing over Belleville and moving toward the Fitchburg and Madison area, climbing about halfway up the sky.

The City of Verona has provided updates regarding recent ordinances and polling locations. Additionally, the police department reported that on Thursday, October 15, 2026, a school bus driver was arrested for O W I while transporting students; no injuries were reported and an investigation is ongoing.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today, you can catch live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out yoga at Insight Wellness, followed by trivia nights starting Monday at Hop Haus and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.

On Thursday, October 15, 2026, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I. Officers developed probable cause during their investigation, and the department is currently reviewing evidence regarding a possible collision with a traffic sign.
Today's flavor of the day is Mint Cookie. Culver's is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM for you to enjoy your treat.
